title: AI Sovereignty Assessment Record
description: One record per AI system. Used by automation/scripts/sovereignty_check.py to evaluate the system against the Sovereignty Law hard gates and advisory controls.

system_name.description: Human-readable name of the AI system or workload.

sensitivity_tier.description: S0 Public / No Institutional Signal; S1 Internal Productivity; S2 Sensitive Enterprise Workflow; S3 High-Alpha / Regulated / Client-Impacting; S4 Sovereign / Core Institutional Knowledge.

compute_assurance_level.description: tier1_owned = owned/air-gapped hardware (structural); tier2_attested = rented compute with hardware attestation (structural); tier3_zdr_cloud = closed model under zero-data-retention agreement (contractual); tier4_standard = default third-party usage without ZDR (contractual, weakest).

owner_present.description: A named, accountable owner exists for this system.

system_inventory_complete.description: System is fully recorded in the AI inventory: purpose, data touched, models, providers, integrations.

zdr_confirmed.description: A zero-data-retention agreement (no storage, no training, no routine human review) is confirmed with each external provider this system uses.

training_on_customer_data_prohibited.description: Provider training on institutional and customer data is contractually prohibited.

metadata_retention_reviewed.description: Provider retention of derived metadata (classifier outputs, monitoring logs, telemetry) has been reviewed, not just content retention.

model_provider_switchable.description: The system can switch models/providers with low friction (model liquidity).

model_routing_documented.description: A routing decision record exists mapping this workload's sensitivity to its assurance level and model path.

agent_tool_access.description: The system includes an agent with access to tools, data, or actions.

agent_permissions_defined.description: Granular role-, classification-, and purpose-based permissions govern what the agent can load, invoke, and suggest.

autonomous_actions.description: The system can commit actions without a human approving each one.

rollback_or_branching_available.description: Actions are taken in reversible branches or have a rollback path before affecting production.

audit_logging_enabled.description: Append-only, queryable logging of initiator, prompt, model, data accessed, and result.

human_oversight_defined.description: A documented human review, override, and escalation model exists.

context_capture_owned_by_org.description: Workflow signal and know-how are captured in an organization-owned context/knowledge layer rather than only inside a provider's system.

shutdown_path_defined.description: Shutdown authority, speed, and handling of in-flight work are defined.
